item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "82e135f2dc0b669a94cd6ab99c6c8622fb67f878c72fdb687393da805f190af5",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "An abbreviation for LocalDef002 specialized to vectors indexed by Fin m.",
      "effect_on_target": "The left side expands to exactly the existential derivative condition on the right side.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "For a finite index type ι, asserts existence of vectors qt and qx such that τ ↦ q x τ has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ q ξ t has derivative qx at x, and qt + coefficient.mulVec qx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the entire pointwise condition being characterized; it includes existence of both partial derivatives and their matrix equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "For every index type ι, real scalar multiplication on real-valued functions on ι is continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of scalar multiplication required to formulate vector-valued derivatives; imposes no assumption on q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid structure from an additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited real additive operations for the scalar-action instances without changing them.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires both derivative assertions and the vector equation to hold together for the same witnesses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "ContinuousMul.to_continuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Continuous multiplication gives continuous scalar multiplication of a type acting on itself by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuity of real scalar multiplication on real coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed field structure and derives nontriviality of its norm from dense norm values.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the nontrivially normed real scalar field required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative action from a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the usual real scalar action used on coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure from a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real semiring operations for the vector module structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires equality of vectors, equivalently equality to zero in every coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over a specified type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Quantifies first qt and then qx, both in Fin m → Real, inside all universal parameter binders.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Builds the underlying semifield using the field's existing arithmetic and inverse operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the inheritance chain supplying ordinary real arithmetic for scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin m is the finite type of natural-number indices i with 0 ≤ i < m.",
      "effect_on_target": "Indexes the m coordinates and both matrix axes; the index type is empty when m = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates every element of Fin n exactly once using finRange n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the finite column index set used in matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition operation from a heterogeneous addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here denotes pointwise addition of qt and coefficient.mulVec qx in the same vector space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "A function f has derivative vector f' at x, with the varying argument approaching x through its full neighborhood filter and the base point fixed at x.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires ordinary two-sided real derivatives of the two vector-valued slices at t and x, respectively; these are pointwise derivatives, not derivatives restricted to a subset.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence, asserting implication in both directions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Equates the defined predicate with its explicitly displayed derivative-and-equation condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts topological semiring compatibility from topological ring compatibility.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports continuity of ordinary real multiplication without adding a hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toContinuousMul",
      "meaning": "Multiplication is jointly continuous in a topological semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real multiplication continuity used to establish continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "Matrix",
      "meaning": "A matrix with row type m, column type n and entry type α is a function m → n → α.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coefficient is an arbitrary real m-by-m array with no additional structural conditions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Matrix.mulVec",
      "meaning": "Multiplies a matrix M by a column vector v by taking the dot product of each row with v: (Mv)i = Σj Mij vj.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coordinate equation is qt_i + Σ_{j=0}^{m-1} coefficient_ij qx_j = 0 for each i.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action from a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real module structure to its usual scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts associative multiplication from a monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited real multiplication for the scalar-action hierarchy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the monoid structure from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real multiplicative monoid governing scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semigroup action from a monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real scalar multiplication while passing to the action structure used for continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "The dimension m is any nonnegative integer, with no positivity hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a nonunital commutative ring's operations while forgetting the requirement of associativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the inheritance chain supplying real multiplication and addition to matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital nonassociative ring, forgetting commutativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains ordinary real operations for subsequent semiring and continuity instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, zero, multiplication and distributivity while forgetting additive inverses.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real algebraic structure required by Matrix.mulVec.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the commutative additive monoid from a nonunital nonassociative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real addition and zero for module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital commutative ring operations from a nonunital normed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Carries real arithmetic from its normed structure into the matrix multiplication instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital seminormed ring structure, forgetting commutativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real seminorm and arithmetic used to obtain the additive normed structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group and pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real additive seminormed structure used in the normed-space and module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital nonassociative semiring structure from a nonunital semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real addition and multiplication along the module-instance inheritance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed field from a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the standard real field and norm underlying the derivative scalar structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, metric and ring operations while forgetting the distinguished multiplicative identity requirements.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited real arithmetic for matrix multiplication and topological ring instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Regards a normed commutative ring as seminormed, retaining its norm, arithmetic and induced pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible real seminormed structures used by module and topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the algebraic field structure from a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real field operations in the scalar module structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, metric and commutative ring operations of a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the scalar real field to the real topology used for continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A normed field is a normed vector space over itself, with multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specifies the standard real scalar action on each real coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure from a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the ordinary real module structure used to build the vector-valued derivative codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number literal using the specified type's numeral instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the literal 0 as an element of Fin m → Real, namely the zero vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Builds the pointwise module structure on functions I → β from a module structure on β.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes Fin m → Real the usual real vector space with coordinatewise scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Functions into additive commutative groups form an additive commutative group under pointwise operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies coordinatewise vector addition, subtraction and zero required by differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "Pi.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Function addition is defined by (f + g)(i) = f(i) + g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the displayed vector sum a coordinatewise sum.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Pi.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero function takes value zero at every index.",
      "effect_on_target": "The right side of the vector equation has all coordinates zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "The function space has the product topology, generated by its coordinate projections.",
      "effect_on_target": "The codomain has the usual finite-dimensional real vector topology; vector derivative convergence is equivalent to convergence in every coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Carries the usual real distance structure into the topology used in derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both independent variables, all vector coordinates and all matrix entries are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field has norm values between any two strictly ordered positive bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures availability of the nontrivially normed scalar field structure for real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "The real addition operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines addition in each coordinate of the vector equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group structure on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the coordinate additive groups used in the vector-valued derivative codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "The real multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines real self-scalar multiplication in the continuity instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "The ring structure on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real additive and multiplicative algebra for module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real number zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines every coordinate of the zero vector in the equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The real commutative ring equipped with its usual norm and metric, assembled from its normed additive group and commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible real arithmetic and topology for matrix multiplication, module structures and continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field equipped with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the ordinary real scalar field, norm and self-vector-space structure for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric is d(x,y) = |x-y|, with its associated uniformity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the usual topology on real coordinates and hence the usual product topology on vectors.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying semiring of a ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains ordinary real arithmetic for the module-instance inheritance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains a semifield's semiring, inverse and division structures while forgetting multiplicative commutativity as a requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the chain supplying the real semiring used by the vector module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Exposes the ordinary real scalar multiplication used in its continuity assertion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the seminorm, pseudometric and commutative ring operations while forgetting multiplicative identity requirements.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the inherited real additive seminormed structure for the normed-space instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the seminormed ring structure, forgetting commutativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm and pseudometric used to construct the scalar topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric structure from a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the usual real pseudometric along the scalar-topology inheritance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Retains a semiring's multiplication, identity, powers and absorbing zero as a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real multiplicative structure governing scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital semiring structure while retaining its addition and multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited real arithmetic for the additive structures used by modules.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology associated with a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the usual real metric topology available for derivative and continuity assertions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 using the type's zero element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures that 0 in the equation denotes the pointwise zero vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "instContinuousSMulForall",
      "meaning": "Coordinatewise continuous scalar actions give a continuous scalar action on the product function space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuous real scalar multiplication on Fin m → Real for both derivative assertions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's ordinary addition as heterogeneous addition with equal input and output types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves the displayed addition to ordinary pointwise vector addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "instIsTopologicalRingReal",
      "meaning": "Real arithmetic is compatible with its topology as a topological ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuity facts needed for real and vector scalar multiplication; it does not assert continuity of q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A finite enumeration of all elements of a type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the matrix-vector sum finite; for the target the enumeration is supplied automatically for Fin m.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "ContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "The scalar action map (a,v) ↦ a • v is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Is a structural prerequisite for HasDerivAt on the vector codomain, already supplied by instances rather than assumed of q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "Pi.instSMul",
      "meaning": "Scalar multiplication of functions is pointwise: (a • f)(i) = a • f(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the coordinatewise scalar action underlying the vector derivatives and continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "Universally quantify a natural number m, including m = 0; its Lean binder is implicit.",
      "Universally quantify a function q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ^m, represented in curried form by q x t i.",
      "Universally quantify a matrix A = coefficient ∈ ℝ^{m×m}, with rows and columns indexed by 0, …, m−1.",
      "Universally quantify x ∈ ℝ and t ∈ ℝ.",
      "On the right side of the equivalence, existentially quantify qt ∈ ℝ^m, then qx ∈ ℝ^m. These witnesses are chosen within the scope of m, q, A, x and t; qx is also within the scope of qt.",
      "The bound variables τ and ξ range over all real numbers in the slices τ ↦ q(x,τ) and ξ ↦ q(ξ,t), respectively."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "There are no additional hypotheses on m, q, A, x or t beyond their types. The real algebraic and topological structures and finite index enumeration are supplied instances."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "LocalDef001(q,A,x,t) holds if and only if there exist vectors qt and qx such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative qt at τ = t, ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative qx at ξ = x, and qt + A qx = 0.",
      "The equation means that for every i with 0 ≤ i < m, qt_i + Σ_{j=0}^{m−1} A_ij qx_j = 0.",
      "Both implications are asserted. After unfolding LocalDef001 and LocalDef002, the left and right propositions are identical."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "ℝ^m is the space of functions Fin m → ℝ, with pointwise addition and scalar multiplication and the product topology of the usual real topology.",
      "A_ij = coefficient i j, and (A v)_i = Σ_{j=0}^{m−1} A_ij v_j; vectors are multiplied on the left by A.",
      "The zero vector is the function i ↦ 0.",
      "The time-slice derivative assertion means lim_{h→0, h≠0} (q(x,t+h) − q(x,t))/h = qt in ℝ^m.",
      "The space-slice derivative assertion means lim_{h→0, h≠0} (q(x+h,t) − q(x,t))/h = qx in ℝ^m.",
      "LocalDef002 is precisely the existence of those two slice derivatives with qt + A qx = 0, defined for any finite coordinate type. LocalDef001 abbreviates its specialization to Fin m."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "For every nonnegative integer m, every real m-component function q of two real variables, every real m-by-m matrix A, and every real point (x,t), the predicate LocalDef001(q,A,x,t) is equivalent to the following condition: both partial derivatives of q at (x,t) exist as vector-valued ordinary real derivatives, and ∂q/∂t(x,t) + A ∂q/∂x(x,t) = 0. More explicitly, there are vectors qt and qx that are respectively the derivatives at t of τ ↦ q(x,τ) and at x of ξ ↦ q(ξ,t), and their sum qt + A qx is the zero vector. The predicate on the left is defined by this same condition, so the proposition is a definitional characterization."
  },
  "restrictions_and_vacuity_risks": [
    "There is no requirement that m be positive. When m = 0, the vector space and matrix type each have one element, both slices are constant into the one-element vector space, and the derivative and equation condition holds automatically; there are no coordinate equations.",
    "The function is defined on all of ℝ × ℝ. Derivatives are unrestricted two-sided derivatives, not one-sided derivatives or derivatives relative to a spatial or temporal domain.",
    "The condition concerns one supplied point (x,t). Universal quantification of x and t makes the equivalence valid at every point, but does not assert that q satisfies the condition at every point.",
    "Existence of the two partial derivatives is part of the defined condition, not an unconditional consequence for every q. If either derivative fails to exist, both sides of the equivalence are false.",
    "No joint differentiability, joint continuity, continuous partial derivatives, or neighborhood regularity of q is required.",
